$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: No state or meaning is conveyed by color alone. The current state (in Current and Nav List stories) uses a blue background fill plus white text, which combines shape/fill change with color.
Focus rings are clear blue borders with strong contrast. Background fills (when present) also have good contrast with text. All controls are clearly distinguishable from background.
Visible text (Dashboard, Team, Settings) exactly matches the screen reader's announced names.
No text truncation or clipping observed in any story or theme.
All focused screenshots show an obvious blue border around the focused item (Dashboard in each case), making focus immediately apparent.
